ns2:course.label: Negotiation
ns2:course.description: This course is an introduction to negotiation, with an emphasis on practical and useful knowledge that students can use throughout their financial lives, including negotiating job offers, auto purchases and sales, and residential purchases and sales. Credit is not given for ACE 221 if credit for ACE 199 NPS has been earned.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for ACE 221 if credit for ACE 199 NPS has been earned.
